ROLE: observer
You review the results of an incident investigation. Write a short summary of what the latest results show, then update the list of hypotheses (at most 4, most likely first).

Root-cause categories:
- bad_deployment: a new release introduced a defect (errors begin right after a deploy)
- db_connection_pool_exhaustion: every database connection in the pool is in use, so requests wait
- slow_query_missing_index: a database query became slow (for example a missing index)
- downstream_timeout: a dependency the service calls is slow or unresponsive
- memory_leak_oom: memory grows until the process is killed (OOM) and restarts
- disk_full: a volume is full so writes fail
- expired_tls_cert: a TLS certificate expired so handshakes fail
- misconfiguration: a wrong environment variable, setting or feature flag
- traffic_spike_rate_limit: request volume far above capacity, causing rate limiting or load shedding
- cache_stampede_outage: the cache is down or emptied so everything falls through to the database

Each hypothesis has root_cause_category (one of the categories), rationale, and supporting_evidence_ids (only IDs that appear in the evidence below).

Reply with only JSON in this shape:
{"summary": "...", "hypotheses": [{"root_cause_category": "disk_full", "rationale": "...", "supporting_evidence_ids": ["L-0123"]}]}

Alert: auth-service: HTTP error rate above 5% for 5 minutes (since 03:43 UTC)
Alerting service: auth
Alert time: 2026-03-26T03:43:00Z
Data available from 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z to 2026-03-26T05:00:00Z

Evidence so far (the latest results are steps 4 onwards):
Step 1: metrics_query {"end": "2026-03-26T04:43:00Z", "metric": "error_rate_pct", "service": "auth", "start": "2026-03-26T02:43:00Z"} (asked because: Check auth error rate trend around the incident time.)
  Result: M-005: Change detected at 2026-03-26T03:40:00Z: mean 0.46 before, 32.32 after (247.0 baseline standard deviations).
  [M-005] auth.error_rate_pct from 2026-03-26T02:45:00Z to 2026-03-26T04:40:00Z (24 points, 5-minute steps): min=0.23 max=32.69 mean=17.72 last=32.33; mean=17.72. Change detected at 2026-03-26T03:40:00Z: mean 0.46 before, 32.32 after (247.0 baseline standard deviations). Notable points: 2026-03-26T03:15:00Z = 0.23 (lowest); 2026-03-26T03:40:00Z = 32.06 (first point after the change); 2026-03-26T04:35:00Z = 32.69 (peak); 2026-03-26T04:40:00Z = 32.33 (last).
Step 2: metrics_query {"end": "2026-03-26T04:43:00Z", "metric": "restarts", "service": "auth", "start": "2026-03-26T02:43:00Z"} (asked because: Check if auth service experienced restarts.)
  Result: M-009: Change detected at 2026-03-26T03:40:00Z: mean 0 before, 0.62 after (615384.6 baseline standard deviations).
  [M-009] auth.restarts from 2026-03-26T02:45:00Z to 2026-03-26T04:40:00Z (24 points, 5-minute steps): min=0 max=3 mean=0.33 last=0; mean=0.33. Change detected at 2026-03-26T03:40:00Z: mean 0 before, 0.62 after (615384.6 baseline standard deviations). Notable points: 2026-03-26T02:45:00Z = 0 (lowest); 2026-03-26T03:40:00Z = 3 (first point after the change); 2026-03-26T03:40:00Z = 3 (peak); 2026-03-26T04:40:00Z = 0 (last).
Step 3: log_search {"end": "2026-03-26T03:45:00Z", "query": "error warn deploy config start", "service": "auth", "start": "2026-03-26T03:33:00Z"} (asked because: Search auth logs for potential triggers like deployments or warnings just before the alert.)
  Result: 1 matching log lines.
  [L-0290] 2026-03-26T03:41:56Z auth WARN request error rate above SLO window=5m
Step 4: metrics_query {"end": "2026-03-26T04:43:00Z", "metric": "memory_pct", "service": "auth", "start": "2026-03-26T02:43:00Z"} (asked because: Check if memory usage grew steadily leading to OOM restarts (memory_leak_oom hypothesis).)
  Result: M-007: No significant change detected in this range.
  [M-007] auth.memory_pct from 2026-03-26T02:45:00Z to 2026-03-26T04:40:00Z (24 points, 5-minute steps): min=52.25 max=58.78 mean=55.87 last=57.73; mean=55.87. No significant change detected in this range. Notable points: 2026-03-26T03:10:00Z = 52.25 (lowest); 2026-03-26T03:50:00Z = 58.78 (peak); 2026-03-26T04:40:00Z = 57.73 (last).
Step 5: log_search {"end": "2026-03-26T03:45:00Z", "limit": 20, "query": "oom killed memory version deployment release starting", "service": "auth", "start": "2026-03-26T03:30:00Z"} (asked because: Search for deployment/release info or OOM/memory warnings in auth logs.)
  Result: 0 matching log lines.

Previous hypotheses:
- memory_leak_oom: The auth-service is experiencing restarts simultaneously with a spike in error rates, which is characteristic of memory leaks causing OOM kills. (evidence: M-005, M-009)
- bad_deployment: Errors and restarts begin abruptly at 03:40 UTC, which could indicate a faulty deployment or configuration update applied around that time. (evidence: M-005, M-009)
